scope: Current app screens and library masters; backups, research diagrams and reference screenshots are not production UI.

conventions.units: Figma logical px; CSS type sizes and line heights use rem.
conventions.content: Props/slots and application state; no recipe, form or household state is a design token.
conventions.layout: 402×874 is a reference viewport. Use fluid width, max content width, safe areas, and native scroll instead of exporting canvas x/y.
conventions.typography: Keep Figma font names; provide licensed web/native font assets in the app.
conventions.variants: Figma Pattern alternatives are layout examples. Code uses data arrays, slots and explicit props, not a component per screen.
